title: Bikewatching
description: An interactive visualization of Bluebikes traffic in Bostom and Cambridge, showing station activity, arrivals, departures, and time-based filtering.

title: Persuasive or Deceptive Visualization
description: An analysis of abortion-clinic availability across the United States, featuring two visualizations and a reflection on persuasive and deceptive data visualization.

title: Education Spending and Gender Gaps in Educational Attainment
description: A collaborative interactive data visualization developed with Heta Joshi and Jade Romero. Using World Bank data from 14 countries across the United States, Europe, and Latin America, we explore how government spending on secondary education relates to gender gaps in upper-secondary educational attainment from 2004 to 2018. An animated bubble chart allows users to compare countries, examine trends over time, and explore different educational attainment measures.
